description:
Goal
One source callable construction owns one runtime object and producer-correlated member plan. Exact calls may use private ABIs; every indirect call consumes only the object's public ABI. Root packaging closes physical contracts so Native/interpreter never reconstruct them from positions, semantic types, or World.

First losses
1. Packaging flattened producer members and reused consumer-position identity.
2. Symbolic positions survived packaging while physical carrier/layout facts were omitted.
3. Direct-surface compatibility could erase settled first-class representation at input/capture projection.
4. Boundary return demand was rebuilt from semantic return type, widening ignored callbacks and filtering zero-width public boundaries.
5. CallEdge::Indirect dropped return flow. Native compensated with a hardcoded one-ValueRef adapter, while transport upgraded every closure ResumePayload to ValueRef even when its solved structure was Nothing.
6. Public wrapper return layout copied the first private member.
7. Runtime reachability treated free inference templates as concrete subjects.

Proven model
- CallableFlowFact owns one producer's function, captures, member resolutions, input mappings, direct/public uses, and consumer-owned result demand. Direct compatibility never clears first-class state.
- TransportLayout is one physical fact: structural shape plus carrier. Nothing cannot carry ValueRef.
- BackendValueLayout closes structural, carrier, tys, and reprs. BackendReturnLayout adds only divergence.
- Positions end at RootBackendProduct. Packaged return flow is Tail, Continue with source contract, or Deliver with source contract and entry. Indirect edges carry flow like direct/dispatch edges.
- ReturnPayload/ResumePayload constrain flow and then disappear.
- Public return is Diverges, Absent, or ValueRef from settled consumer demand across all members. Mixed absent/value members are invalid. Semantic return type and first-member private layout are not authorities.
- Distinct source constructions remain distinct objects when joined. They agree on public ABI; runtime FnId/code pointer owns indirect identity.
- Construction identity is allocation-only.
- Runtime reachability grounds free variables to Any while preserving known structure.

Spike proofs
- Construction instrumentation found zero call-time construction uses; fallback deletion preserves Enum/Range controls.
- ea1920945 seals routes and deletes endpoint catalogs/scans; focused gates and strict clippy pass.
- 568c80c30 proves closed public return; 4bc36c472 proves shared BackendValueLayout and deletes input/capture scans and caches.
- 4c7ba079b is the durable red opaque Enum.each ignored-result proof.
- f7208331f proves first-class singleton inputs cannot reuse direct-only shapes.
- b0822a1a1 preserves first-class capture state and deletes 139 lines of semantic-type return-demand reconstruction.
- a7c9844bc proves two branch refs remain two producer boundaries, both Absent, with one indirect consumer.
- Dynamic probing proved each_step ResumePayload is singleton, Ignore, unconsumed, structural Nothing, yet was assigned ValueRef solely by callsite kind.
- 5fbef9c96 is the green integrated solution spike: indirect flow retained, zero-width carrier absent, sealed source consumed, boxed adapter deleted. Stat 88 additions/153 deletions. Opaque interp/JIT, consumed opaque control, Range scalar/2, direct-only inventory, fmt/check/clippy pass.
- a95594f54 preserves the larger producer/member WIP but is not a landing candidate alone.

Test intent audit
- Keep semantic controls: Tail closed routes, direct-only callables absent from wrapper inventory, producer-correlated member ownership, allocation-only identity, indirect calls without private targets, equal sealed captures for concordant members, and actual interpreter/JIT resume behavior.
- Replace stale mechanics: semantic-type-derived public return shapes, per-surface public ABIs, exact boundary/capture counts, arbitrary first-wrapper selection, curried_add telemetry identity, and hand-built edge fixtures missing sealed return flow.
- Treat proven reductions as improvements: quicksort's reachable frontier falls from 21 to 17 and should be a <=17 bound plus required/cold membership and schedule-set equality; fixture 00181's exact inventory of 10 disappears in favor of packaged-set closure; captures leave return payload lanes; an unconsumed suspension may allocate less.
- Rebaseline the print-only suspension resource fixture downward without raw FnId identity, but retain a consumed continuation control that resumes in interpreter and JIT and observes captured state.
- Preserve real reds: direct surfaces must not erase first-class state; enum_take_drop_split must not box its direct-only predicate or panic natively; false no-matching-clause diagnostics must disappear; corpus maximum ascents stays <=4.
- Restore the unrelated reusable-cons alias-fallback coverage. Repair the weakened distinct-return-flow helper so it compares the sealed source layout with the caller return layout.
- Tests measure intent with behavior, set membership, monotone bounds, and closed authorities. They do not force deleted positions, endpoint catalogs, semantic return reconstruction, or private layouts back into the packaged model.

Landing strategy
Reconcile a95594f54, ea1920945, 568c80c30, 4bc36c472, f7208331f, b0822a1a1, and 5fbef9c96 into one final commit from integration. Prefer shared contracts and deletion. Remove call-time construction, packaged position lookups, endpoint catalogs, input scans/caches, duplicate layouts, blanket closure carrier rules, type-derived callable return demand, empty-return filtering, first-member public return selection, and the boxed one-lane adapter.

Tests assert production intent. Add no code comments.

Acceptance
- Prove producer ownership, allocation-only identity, monotone first-class carrier, consumer-owned Absent/ValueRef, indirect sealed flow, shared layouts, and no packaged symbolic ABI positions.
- Opaque ignored/consumed, Enum operator-ref/take/drop/split/search, Range scalar/2/3, multi_relay, resource, direct-only, and quicksort interp/JIT/build controls pass.
- Resource assertions accept proven decreases while rejecting increased work, storage, reachability, or diagnostic volume.
- cargo test --lib and strict all-target clippy pass except the three known raw-telemetry handler baselines owned by fz-1ah.12.
- Release fixture 00181 emits no diagnostics at about 0.05-0.06s; telemetry remains 1,114 records rather than about 3,200.

Known baseline
At pristine ca59b76ac exactly three library tests fail because handlers expect copied telemetry metadata: compiler2_notes_top_level_types_into_the_global_scope, compiler2_protocol_domain_marker_stays_type_owned_while_dispatch_revises_when_impls_land, and source_publication_defers_local_macro_expansion_until_function_demand. fz-1ah.12 owns them.

Packaged-position spike
- 6fcd287f1 and f543ea9c2 prove the RootBackendProduct cutoff with 157 additions/478 deletions, net -321.
- BackendProgram, BackendExecutable, BackendConstructionWrapper, NativeProgram, NativeBody, and NativeCallableBoundary contain no TransportPosition. An exhaustive destructuring test makes added packaged fields a compile failure.
- One BackendExecutable.value_layouts map closes local structural shape, carrier, tys, and reprs. Existing closed input, capture, return, and return-flow layouts remain authoritative.
- Native and interpreter no longer perform ValueId -> TransportPosition -> TransportLayout rejoins, World/type reconstruction, runtime scans, or caching.
- TransportPosition remains only in pre-package planning forms where it keys facts; the temporary producer-position-to-allocation-identity map is consumed before BackendProgram construction.
- Focused behavior, fmt/check, and strict clippy pass. Full library results exactly match rejected 5441731ea, proving no new failures.

Promotion discoveries
- A nested Enum predicate legitimately carries a pre-package first-class boundary because its enclosing reducer crosses that boundary. The old boundary-empty assertion was at the wrong layer. Packaged/native exact dispatch is the valid invariant.
- Native then discarded an already-settled exact target solely because the zero-capture predicate also had a runtime carrier. Exact dispatch is valid when the target requires no physical capture inputs; captured targets retain runtime-identity fallback.
- Enum/quicksort warnings were genuine source-domain gaps, not stale or duplicate telemetry. Valid helper domains were declared; polymorphic recursive list specs that changed inference were rejected; Any-domain helpers keep behavior and close with explicit divergence.
- The old reusable-cons alias fixture improved from 0 to 1 reuse because producer lowering erases its unused argument. Coverage now separates that improvement from a materialized-holder fixture that proves the still-reachable live-alias fallback.
- The temporary <=5 ascent allowance was rejected. Runtime reachability grounds pattern-projectable tuple/list/map slots but preserves callable-arrow correlation that pattern dispatch cannot inspect; this removes spurious reducer rounds and restores the <=4 corpus ceiling.
- No diagnostic filtering, telemetry compensation, refcount compensation, or packaged authority was added.

Fresh audit of ee6d3fbe0: FAIL
- runtime_envelope was not polarity-safe: grounding nested variables to Any inside negative tuple/list/map signatures broadened exclusions and could prune valid dispatch. Promotion must add a production negative-template reachability proof and transform unresolved exclusions conservatively.
- Runtime-library Enum/list/quicksort source edits were compensations for genuine partial-domain warnings and changed negative take_every/drop_every from function_clause halt to panic. Remove all such source edits from this ticket. fz-1ah.11 already owns the subsequent CLI/library diagnostic work once .23 unblocks it.
- One quicksort test still pinned exactly 17 and must become <=17 without weakening required/cold membership or schedule-set equality.
- Remove unused native construction capture helper parameters.
- Packaged-position cutoff, producer ownership, captured runtime identity, consumed suspension, release 00181 zero diagnostics/1,114 events, and independent library/clippy gates passed audit.

Re-audit of polarity correction: FAIL
- Tuple/list/map polarity passed substitution and reachability probes, but resource payloads were omitted. Production typed callsite preconditions can inspect resource payloads, so resource(alpha) incorrectly pruned a resource(integer) row. Promotion must transform resource payloads with the same polarity model and prove positive, negative, nested, and production reachability cases.
- Callable arrows may remain correlated: the analogous production probe retained both rows, and dispatch cannot inspect arrow internals.
- All prior audit findings were corrected and independent gates remained at the authorized baseline.

Final model audit of resource correction: FAIL
- Cofinite unresolved variable sets were mishandled under negative polarity. any\alpha nested under an exclusion became runtime top and erased valid tuple/resource instantiations. Promotion must distinguish finite/cofinite var sets and prove double-negation substitution.
- Region::Type has a second authority mismatch: semantic reachability compares full callable Ty identity/arrow detail, while Native runtime_type_predicate observes only closure kind. Callsite dispatch can construct Type regions from callable surface inputs. Promotion must prove and align semantic selection with runtime-observable authority; do not merely preserve callable correlation to hold the ascent ceiling or blindly ground arrow internals.
- Tuple/list/map/resource finite polarity and prior gates passed.

comments.text: Refinement-only model correction: downstream must never infer or reverse-engineer an observable discriminator from Ty. Preserve an authoritative observation witness forward, or collapse targets where they diverge. Real-fixture spikes found zero direct-callsite runtime-predicate collisions. Callable construction edges do collide, but exact {[], int} vs {[int], int} edges resolve to the same executable and must not motivate dispatch. Remaining split-family distinct targets have identical transported shapes; drop_while differs only in boolean lane identity while retaining the same tuple structure. Structural DispatchMatrix capability is therefore not proof of necessity. Current lead: DispatchDemand is forward-derived from EntryDispatch and convergence-collapse is the existing key abstraction, but CallableSurface/CallableFlowEdge retain only Ty surfaces. Prove whether ignored tuple-union correlation and scalar literals should collapse at key formation; do not synthesize patterns later.

Proven refinement boundary from the real Enum fixture:

- CallTargetSummary already owns the authoritative pair (surface_inputs, exact activation).
- closure_callee_demand discards target.activation and retains only surface_inputs. CallableDemand and CallableFlowBuilder then transport surfaces without their resolution.
- callable_flow_resolution_edges_product later calls world.activation_key over producer captures plus those surfaces, reconstructing the discarded target relation.
- take_every exposes 3 transported surfaces, all belonging to 1 exact activation and 1 physical shape row. They must collapse; there is no dispatch decision.
- drop_while exposes 3 transported surfaces belonging to 2 exact activations and 2 shape rows. The downstream closure CallTargetSummary facts contain both targets. Type-derived cone seeding reconstructs only the :true target and misses the mixed :false|:true target, while settled flow contains both. Reconstruction is therefore both unnecessary and incomplete.
- The owner activation has no local lambda CallTargetSummary because invocation occurs downstream. Exact target evidence must flow backward through callable demand/value joins to the producer; the producer must refine that preserved relation into its flow fact, never parse Ty or recompute activation.
- Direct exact resolutions and unresolved/public surfaces are distinct domains. Exact calls preserve CallTargetSummary edges. A first-class public surface may be combined with authoritative producer identity to resolve a target for the first time. Do not put both into one resolved surface set.
- Delete the synthetic pattern-from-Ty spike direction. Dispatch capability is not proof that a discriminator is necessary.

Next spike gates before implementation: prove direct CallSiteSummary closure over the whole demand cone already includes the target members currently added by type_derived_flow_resolutions; delete the type-derived phase disposably and observe membership/fixpoint behavior. Then TDD a split CallableDemand/CallableFlowBuilder model that carries exact direct resolutions and only resolves genuinely public surfaces at the producer.

title: fz-k22: preserve producer callable constructions behind one public indirect ABI
